calibrationCaveats.text: The estimate is not a wall-clock runtime benchmark.
The estimate does not claim lower cost, lower spend, or faster training.
Hardware, kernel fusion, memory bandwidth, dataloader, and compiler effects may dominate real runtime.
The estimate says nothing about accuracy, convergence, stability, or scientific validity.
Any numeric estimator implementation must later carry calibration source, version, and residual/error notes.

exampleBoundaries.allowedUse: private example of how batch/epoch/parameter metadata could shape a budget estimate
exampleBoundaries.blockedUse: public claim about MNIST training savings or estimator accuracy

exampleBoundaries.allowedUse: private example of graph/layer cost visibility
exampleBoundaries.blockedUse: claim that traced graph cost equals full runtime cost

exampleBoundaries.allowedUse: downstream advisory input for PINN diagnostics
exampleBoundaries.blockedUse: claim of better PDE solution quality or scientific correctness

nonClaims: PROD-A2 is a private specification for a training cost estimator; it does not implement or execute an estimator.
PROD-A2 defines supported inputs, output fields, calibration caveats, example boundaries, and blocked claims only.

PROD-A2 does not claim training savings, estimator accuracy, runtime performance, model-quality improvement, compiler correctness, semantic preservation, public product readiness, hardware readiness, silicon readiness, reviewer approval, or broad EML advantage.
PROD-A2 respects the D109 hold and does not start D110 or consume a reviewer response.

outputSchemaFields.meaning: Stable identifier for the private estimate packet.
Compact description of accepted inputs and missing optional context.
Expression-level cost profile when symbolic expressions are supplied.
Layer/node-level profile when graph-summary input is supplied.
Epoch/batch/parameter context used to scale a private advisory estimate.
Required caveats attached to the estimate.
Claims that the estimate must not imply.
Private reviewer actions before implementation or public copy.

supportedInputs.boundary: Static expression cost shape only; no runtime measurement or training outcome prediction.
Profiler-shape input only; no guarantee that traced graph captures all runtime work.
Budget-context metadata only; no claim that training dynamics, convergence, or data pipeline cost are fully modeled.
Reviewer-supplied rows must remain labeled as supplied estimates, not measured truth.
